leadText:
Dragonite Island (Japanese: カイリューの Island) is an -exclusive location located off the coast of the Kanto region. It was featured in A Test in Paradise!.

Dragonite Island is an island solely populated by members of the evolutionary line. It has a beach, forests, a river, and a waterfall. Behind the waterfall is a small cave where local Dratini like to shed their skin. The local use their weather-controlling powers to create constant storms around the island to keep it hidden, though the living on the island sometimes take shipwrecked people there to recover. It is also located in an area without coverage, making the task of pinpointing its location impossible.

 and Goh visited the island after hearing rumors of its existence from Professor Cerise. During their visit, Ash helped a Dragonair learn how to fly. Shortly afterwards, it evolved into a and chose to join Ash's team. Ash and Goh later told Professor Cerise about the island, but he chose to keep its existence a secret from the public to keep the mystery surrounding it alive.
